blocks.text: Each item has a rate and unit: per item, metre or hour. “From” prices require an agreed scope. We confirm the final cost before work starts.

An initial estimate from a description, photos or video is free. A call-out with basic diagnostics costs 246 zł even without a repair; if work proceeds, this amount is included in its price. Extended electrical fault location is priced separately, from 350 zł. The minimum visit is 246 zł; cleaning has a 250 zł minimum and minimum hours. Travel tops labour up to the minimum; chargeable out-of-town mileage is extra. Unlisted repairs: 199 zł/h. Moving: minimum 2 hours, with the first 80 km of the agreed route included in the van rate. Materials are agreed separately.

blocks.text: The four things people usually worry about

items: I don't know what I'll pay
The calculator prices your selected items. We confirm the price before starting. Additional work proceeds only after you approve its cost.
What if they don't show up
We confirm an arrival time before departure. If it changes or we are running late, we let you know in advance.
Sheeting on the furniture, vacuum at the drill, packaging leaves with us. The flat stays liveable.
They'll take on something they don't know
Electrical scope is confirmed before the visit; we do not work on gas systems or the building supply connection.
